evidence.note: CoBa treats test-time scaling as a compute-allocation problem and routes cheap answer-agreement evidence versus a small number of strong-verifier calls, reaching majority-voting/self-evaluation-level accuracy on math and symbolic reasoning benchmarks while using roughly half the parameter-weighted tokens.
evidence.title: CoBa: Cost-Effective Test-Time Scaling via Compute-Balanced Routing

name: tiered verification (rule-based V0, lightweight judge V1, process verifier V2, strong deep verifier V3)
